summary: Issue-link and mark-implemented gates require explicit #N or owner/repo issue URLs, ignore fenced code and HTML comments (including tilde fences and unclosed blocks), replay Development sidebar connect/disconnect events by global issue id in chronological order, and ignore removed files in the Feature fragment gate.
migration_impact: Adopters should import the updated plate-pr-gates.yml (regenerate from plate-core or run scripts/build_plate_pr_gates_workflow.py after merge). Required check name remains pr-gates; closing-keyword scans no longer treat prose digits or example URLs without owner/repo as links.
agent_notes: Refs #1231 items 2–4. Regenerate plate-pr-gates.yml via scripts/build_plate_pr_gates_workflow.py after editing gate scripts.
